content:
I would make me extremely happy, if you checked out my vegetarian recipe collection website called Vege Dreams.
It’s a personal project of mine, where I share my favorite vegetarian recipes that I have tried and loved over the years. From Irish soda bread to Italian Spaghetti Carboanara (without bacon, of course!), there’s something for everyone.
You can also find some vegan recipes there, and some recipes are very easy to adapt to be vegan-friendly, usually just remove cheese, or replace dairy with plant-based alternatives.
The website is actually a fork of my brothers website Tofu Dreams, which is focused on vegan recipes. I wanted to create something similar, but with a focus on vegetarian dishes, because I don’t think I’d be able to be a vegan, plus I had some of mine recipes in mind, so I really wanted to have something similar. dhonus/tofu-dreams 🌱 My vegan cooking site with original recipes. (Hugo with SEO, automatic image compression, “cooking mode” and more) HTML 1 1 My version of the recipe collection is styled diffrently though, I am using Bulma.io CSS framework, which i really like. Feel free to check my code on Github, and maybe even fork it for your own recipe collection! ondrejhonus/vege-dreams 🧀 My vegetarian cooking site with original recipes. (Mostly italian style foods and baked goods) HTML 0 0
title: Vege Dreams: My Vegetarian Recipe Collection

content:
I have made my first ever website when I was in 6th grade in primary school (I was 11). It was a very simple website made with, very coincidentally… Hugo!
Hugo was introduced to me by my brother, who already had some experience with it, so he set me up with a very basic template and I got to work. You can still find the website on GitHub. It’s actually my first ever GitHub repository! ondrejhonus/xyz personal website HTML 0 0 Over the years, I have made several versions of my personal website, each time using something else. Before I have made this specific website, I had a website made with HTML/CSS with a CSS framework called Bulma.io.
This time, I said to myself, “Why not try Hugo again?”. It was pretty simple, and looking at it now, after all those years, It has come a long way, and the themes actually look pretty good.
So here I am, making my first blog on my new personal website, made with Hugo and the Blowfish theme, which you can check out here.
title: Making this website
